about.title: About {product}
about.tagline: Every repo. One window. AI you can trust.
about.intro: IntelyIDE is a fast, lightweight IDE for people who work across several repositories at once, with AI agents that help you move faster and never run unsupervised.
about.feature.repos.title: All repos, side by side
about.feature.repos.text: See the changes of every repository in one tree, then commit and push each one separately.
about.feature.agents.title: AI agents with guardrails
about.feature.agents.text: Claude and other agents work in roles with their own models. Permission checks and hard stops keep commit and push in your hands.
about.feature.rewind.title: Rewind any run
about.feature.rewind.text: Every agent run is snapshotted first, so one click takes it back.
about.feature.git.title: Git, fully loaded
about.feature.git.text: Commit graph, blame, hunk staging, rebase, cherry-pick and stash across all your repos.
about.feature.workspace.title: Everything in one place
about.feature.workspace.text: Editor, terminal, search and your Happy tools, without leaving the window.
about.feature.light.title: Light by design
about.feature.light.text: Optional modules cost nothing until you switch them on.
